name: WriteSerialChar
evidence: original assembly: waits on the status word at 0x1000F130 and writes a character to the serial port at 0x1000F180 (WriteConsoleChar calls it)

name: BufferOutputChar
evidence: gathers characters in g_outputLine and hands the line to PrintToDebugConsole at a newline or when it is full (PrintBuffered's output)

name: WriteConsoleChar
evidence: writes a character to the serial port with WriteSerialChar, a newline as a carriage return and a line feed; g_outputHook's default

name: FormatExponent
evidence: writes a double through the output hook in the form 0.ddddddde+n (the formatter's %e and %f)

name: FormatOutput
evidence: the small formatter of %c %d %u %o %x %s %e %f with l, h and a zero-padded width, writing each character through its character function (PrintToOutputHook and PrintBuffered call it)

name: PrintToOutputHook
evidence: formats its arguments through FormatOutput to g_outputHook (RunRequestThread and the TLB set-up print with it)

name: PrintBuffered
evidence: formats its arguments through FormatOutput to BufferOutputChar (FlushOutputBuffer, ResetIop and the CD/DVD library print with it)
